about: Two planted defects in architecture memory, applied only to the benchmark copy of the source: a scan forgets where it left each scope, so the next look finds nothing recorded and re-reads everything; and a freshness check asks the index once per fact instead of once for all of them.

mutations.find: export const scopesInto = (was, scopes) => ({ ...was, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(scopes).filter(([, v]) => v.hash).map(([k, v]) => [k, { hash: v.hash }])) });
const scopes = model ? measure(all, model, source) : {};
mutations.replace: const scopes = model ? Object.assign({}, ...all.map((f) => measure([f], model, source))) : {};
